mainEntity.name: Does this software determine whether someone committed fraud?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It organizes research and checks structure, not guilt. Names, shared addresses, registry entries and outliers are not proof. A qualified human must assess source meaning, context and any legal conclusion.

mainEntity.name: Are real investigations or personal records included?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The release contains code, generic methods and synthetic examples. Newly acquired public records can still contain personal information. Store them privately and never post evidence in repository issues.

mainEntity.name: Is this an official government project or reporting channel?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This is an independent open-source project. It does not accept fraud tips, file reports or contact subjects. Use current official guidance before any human-directed reporting decision.

mainEntity.name: Does using the toolkit qualify me for a reward?

acceptedAnswer.text: No reward or commission is promised. Current written agency terms govern eligibility, originality and required milestones. Social-media announcements, structural checks and public anomalies do not establish entitlement.

mainEntity.name: Does local storage mean no information leaves my machine?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Your selected model may receive prompts and tool output. Search engines and source websites receive queries or requests. This landing page includes no forms or analytics; GitHub Pages may log hosting requests.
